content: OpenAI-compatible streaming failures (OpenAI help, OpenRouter errors doc, openai-python#2699): once the 200 and SSE headers are sent, a rate limit or upstream failure arrives as an SSE payload with a top-level error object and finish_reason 'error', not as an HTTP status; SDK-level retry logic is skipped entirely for stream reads, so the client must handle it. 429 responses carry retry-after / retry-after-ms and x-ratelimit-* headers which should be honoured before backoff with jitter. Failover after streaming begins is impossible because partial content is already committed. Compatible servers vary: Ollama's /v1 endpoint has broken streaming with tools; local servers have no rate limiter at all and fail by exhaustion instead of 429; JSON-schema response_format support varies.
